tokens.name: bone-black
tokens.usage: Charred bone -- the ground of the world. Page/app background.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Raised surface -- cards, panels, table cells.

tokens.name: ash-hi
tokens.usage: Hover / inset state of a raised surface.

tokens.name: vellum
tokens.usage: Calfskin -- primary text. Never pure white; nothing in this world is white.

tokens.name: vellum-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text -- descriptions, captions, dim/muted copy.

tokens.name: vellum-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and rules -- eyebrow labels, hairline dividers, table headers.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Oxidised copper -- the accent. Carries every interactive and arcane element: links, buttons, glow, active/selected state.

tokens.name: verdigris-lo
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis verdigris -- deep accent fields, gradients, background washes.

tokens.name: orpiment
tokens.usage: Arsenic yellow -- spent on nothing but gold and value. A flash of this colour always means loot; no other UI element may use it.

tokens.name: madder
tokens.usage: Madder lake -- heat, danger, blood. Alarm states: a hunt, fire, a critical timer.

tokens.name: lapis
tokens.usage: Ground lapis -- reserved for the voice: incantations, portals, and whatever answers them.

tokens.name: flint
tokens.usage: Ground stone -- walls and unsymbolic material tones. No romantic meaning, by design.

tokens.name: malachite
tokens.usage: Ground malachite -- moss, ivy, foliage, the world outside the walls.

tokens.name: umber
tokens.usage: Raw umber -- leather, straps, satchels, wardrobe.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Structural hairline border -- sigil rings, card outlines, table header rule.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: The 1px gap colour inside hairline card grids (.grid, .plates, .pigments, .strata), and section top-border.

tokens.name: space-hairline
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards in .grid/.plates/.pigments/.strata -- filled with line-soft, reads as a hairline separator.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight internal gaps, e.g. sigil glyph spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Stamp chip padding, stat row gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding (.grid > div), table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Plate/mood-tile padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Beat (loop step) padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a card grid following a heading block.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical block padding between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner in the identity is square. No border-radius is used anywhere -- hairline borders replace the rounded-corner/soft-shadow convention.
